fields.label: etchcap
fields.description: A tight cluster of glossy black caps with violet gill-edges, crusted with fine grey grain at the base. It lives on the chemistry of the Dark's collapse-grain and grows only in the low hollows where that grain settles.

fields.label: etchcap caps
fields.description: Dense black fungus caps with violet undersides, grown on grain chemistry in the Dark. Rich, mineral and faintly sweet; cooks prize them above any other mushroom.

fields.label: etch-hollow
fields.description: A low bowl of black stone where the Dark's falling grain has settled and eaten the rock to a fine, chemically active crust. Nothing sun-fed grows here; one thing lives on the grain.

fields.label: gharrek
fields.description: A flat, many-gilled crawler the size of a dinner plate that clings in the lee of the crags. In the still it lies shut, cold and nearly invisible on the obsidian, overlapping slate plates drawn tight over its gills. At every gust every gharrek on the map opens at once and feeds on the stirred air, a sudden carpet of fluttering verdigris gill-fans with a faint flameless glow; then they shut again. Harmless, and the meal that makes the crag hunters hunt in the gusts.

fields.label: gill-ash
fields.description: A pinch of pale grey-green ash, a few flecks of it still glowing faintly. It sheds from the gill-fans of a gharrek that has fed well on the gusts, and it burns hot and flameless when it is pressed and refined.

fields.label: dormant
fields.description: Shut tight in the still, waiting for the next gust.

fields.label: sorter
fields.description:
A slow, stoop-backed digger the colour of dusty umber, with very long, pale, many-jointed fingers that it never seems to stop using. It works the black glass of the crags with a patient, shy care, turning over shards and stones and setting them down again somewhere else. Wherever one has been, things are a little too neat.

Colonists call it the sorter. It can be tamed and trained, and a tame sorter cannot leave a mess alone: it hauls, and it picks the filth off a floor and eats it.

fields.label: ring of shards
fields.description: A low ring of obsidian shards stood upright in the dust, each one set a hand's width from the next. It was made with great care, and not recently.

fields.label: tidy den
fields.description: A low den mouth dug into the black rock, lined with scavenged scrap: bent steel strips, a component, shards stood in rows, and a small pile of faintly glowing berries by the entrance, stacked far too neatly. Nothing is living in it just now.

fields.label: salvage cache
fields.description: A tidy stack of salvage set squarely on the rock: plates, a coil of cable, a few components, all of it squared off as if for inspection. It was made with great care, and not recently.

fields.label: tholin dust
fields.description: A reddish-brown, faintly oily powder with a greasy sheen: what is left when the Dark's grain has eaten stone or steel. It sweeps up easily, and refines to chemfuel.

fields.label: make chemfuel from tholin
fields.description: Refine tholin dust into chemfuel.

fields.label: make chemfuel from gill-ash
fields.description: Press and refine gill-ash into chemfuel.

fields.label: the Dark
fields.description: Aurora-ash hangs in the air like a substance. It swallows light in transit; only warmth thins it.

fields.label: the Unveiling
fields.description: The Dark folds away all at once and the country shows itself, naked and lit. Then it folds back.

fields.label: Witchfire storm
fields.description: Two atmospheres igniting into a chemistry native to neither: light and violence with no name. The Dark persists inside it. Some of the thunder is not thunder.

fields.label: murk
fields.description: The Dark hangs in the air here and swallows light. Sight, aim and fighting all suffer. Warmth thins it.

fields.label: krizzak
fields.description: A soft, dark moth-thing the size of a hand, wings the deep plum of a bruise and a pale glassy mouth like a lamp-glass that holds a faint stolen glow. It eats light. Swarms settle on glow plants and dim them, and cluster on lit lamps until the lit radius shrinks to a smear; a perimeter going dark one lamp at a time is the warning. It takes no power and does no harm to hull or hand, and it scatters from heat.

fields.label: summ
fields.description: A vast, low, many-legged grazer of the deep crags whose voice is the thunder. Its long armoured body is slung on six thick limbs; great resonating throat-sacs down its neck and chest glow a faint storm-violet when it is charged. It grazes on the Dark itself, gathering the charge the Dark carries until it must call it out, and in a Witchfire storm the roll heard a few seconds before a flash with no lightning is a summ calling. It regenerates its wounds, sees by the glow of its own throat, and burns in daylight. It never stops growing.

fields.label: ombrathia
fields.description: A heavy, low-slung night hunter, bear-broad through the forequarters, on thick legs ending in long hooked claws. Its hide is black mottled with bruise-purple, and its short, fanged muzzle carries a tight cluster of small eyes that glow a pale violet. Its back is a great crown of long sensory quills, banded black and violet, fanning from neck to haunch. In the Dark it hunts by feel, its quills picking up the tremor of anything moving; before it lunges and pins, it raises them in a clattering hackle. It does not throw them, and it does not chase far. The crag-tellers count it among the black, many-eyed kin, and say its line was bred by the dark-robed masters of old as their hunting hound.

fields.label: daylight burn
fields.description: Its hide is made for perpetual night. Under an open daylit sky it blisters and smokes; in shade or darkness the burn fades.

fields.label: saevitha
fields.description: A mouthless nightside predator, fourteen eyes, seven to a side, clustered above a damp black hide. It has no bite - it kills by grip, draining the warmth from whatever it holds until the cold itself is the wound. Solitary and untameable; its mane and hide are only ever taken from a kill, never sheared. Of all the black, many-eyed kin it is the one the old tales most often set at a dark master's heel.

fields.label: ishvarith
fields.description: A cat-large ambush stalker of the Abyss, long and low as a lizard, its body sheathed in ridged black plates that run on into a long, tapering whip of a tail. Its narrow wedge of a head is ringed all the way round with small dark eyes, so nothing approaches it unseen from any side, and its hide is the dull black of old obsidian, drinking what little light there is. An ishvarith will not cross firelight or a heated space - a lit camp neutralises it without a fight. Solitary and untameable. Like the rest of its black, many-eyed kin it seems made rather than born, the work of some old and patient dark hand.

fields.deathMessage: {0} has been drained of warmth to death.
fields.label: cold drain
cold-drain wound
fields.description: Flesh drained of warmth by a saevitha's grip. Aches like frostbite and is slow to heal.

fields.label: wickwood tree
fields.description:
A slim, black-barked tree of the Abyss whose sap carries a cold-burning light. The crown glows a steady blue-white bright enough to grow crops beneath it, and the Dark, which swallows every lamp men build, does not touch it.

Wickwoods can be extracted and replanted anywhere. A ring of them is a farm's sun.

fields.label: fold-lamp
fields.description:
An iron firebox with a narrow brass throat. It burns wood or chemfuel, gives off heat and a warm light, and throws a lane of warm air ahead of it.

In the Abyss, that lane holds the Dark open: a clear corridor of air toward wherever the throat points, for watching a path. Anywhere else it is simply a good cold-night heater-lamp.

defs.label: the Dark itself (watched, never studied at a bench)

fields.label: the Dark itself (watched, never studied at a bench)
fields.description: Not a building. Some things are learned only by standing in the Dark and watching what warmth does to it.

fields.label: heat-folding
fields.description:
Warmth pushes the Dark back. Shape the warmth, and you shape where the air stays clear: a firebox with a narrow brass throat throws a lane of warm, clear air ahead of it.

Unlocks the fold-lamp.

fields.label: the Dark folds from warmth
fields.description:
An observation, not a study. In the Abyss the Dark is a substance in the air, and it thins where it is warm. Someone has to stand in a clear pocket beside a fire and see it happen before anyone can reason about it.

This is learned by watching, never at a research bench.
